known_issues.reason: Faithful encoding of Q3 = No ('Is patient known with stable angina?' No -> ACS likely) as (no (clinical_finding Stable angina, Known present)). Gate/tool limitation, not a missing check.

judgment_calls.topic: Diagnosis rules not gated on red-box criteria
judgment_calls.decision: The ECG/pain-character flowchart sits inside the red box, but the ACS, tension pneumothorax and pneumonia rules are anchored only on chest pain and the flowchart's own branches, not on the red-box items.
judgment_calls.alternatives: AND the whole red-box or-list into each diagnosis rule (more literal, very long). As built, rules can fire for chest pain without any red-box item (more often than the page).

judgment_calls.decision: Urgent, as the page says 'Give urgent attention' and 'Manage and refer urgently'. The Chest pain warning sign already carries Very urgent in warning_signs.ts.
judgment_calls.alternatives: "Very urgent" to match the warning sign (Will's briefing allows it where the warning sign already carries that level).

judgment_calls.decision: Image shows ECG abnormal feeding the 'Is chest pain/discomfort any of' box (same as Q1 = No), not straight to ACS likely. ACS rule = chest pain AND (ECG abnormal OR Q1 = No) AND (any feature OR not known stable angina).
judgment_calls.alternatives: ECG abnormal -> ACS directly (2023-style reading); not what the 2026 image shows.

judgment_calls.decision: Read as all of: sudden breathlessness AND (more resonant OR decreased breath sounds OR pain on one side) AND deviated trachea, gated on Q1 = Yes (worse on palpation or breathing).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Any of the listed signs; or not gated on Q1.

judgment_calls.decision: Measurement of Risk of cardiovascular disease (%) > 20, with a measure task so it is checked for.
judgment_calls.alternatives: At increased risk of cardiovascular disease (finding), which drops the 20% threshold (fires more often).

judgment_calls.decision: 'Patient has stable angina' not turned into a diagnosis rule: its only evidence is the known diagnosis.
judgment_calls.alternatives: probable Stable angina rule from (no features) AND known stable angina.
